basic_info.description: Come see this diamond in the making.  This is a superb Single Family House in one of the hottest neighborhoods of San Francisco, the Parkside community.   Currently, this is a two-bedroom plus!  You will love the potential here with an additional bedroom and bonus area in the garage.   There is all the ceiling height you need to add even more room and additional square footage.  In addition, there is a tremendous sun-drenched backyard.  One of the best features is this super quiet street.  You will love this location close to the beach and zoo.  The city has completely redeveloped shops and this neighborhood.  In addition, the huge bonus is super easy access to Tech companies, Bio Tech and the Peninsula with the 280 Freeway entrance close by.
